dimensions.assessment: Affects electric transmission providers, the Department of Energy, the Department of the Treasury, and taxpayers or entities undertaking transmission projects.
dimensions.evidence: A transmission provider subject to transmission planning required by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission... may... conduct a transmission modernization study

dimensions.assessment: Provides tax credit incentives and streamlines environmental review processes for qualifying grid reconductoring projects.
dimensions.evidence: The issuance of a Federal permit or other Federal approval authorizing a covered project is deemed to be a categorical exclusion under the National Environmental Policy Act

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to include high-performance transmission property in clean electricity tax credits, impacting federal revenues.
dimensions.evidence: any high-performance transmission property... shall be included as part of the clean electricity investment credit

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Internal Revenue Code, establishes NEPA review categorical exclusions, and sets up reporting and study requirements for transmission providers.
dimensions.evidence: The issuance of a Federal permit or other Federal approval authorizing a covered project is deemed to be a categorical exclusion

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to property placed in service in taxable years beginning after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to property placed in service in taxable years beginning after the date of the enactment

missing_information: Quantitative estimates of total federal tax revenue reduction resulting from the investment credit expansion
importance_detail.rationale: Promotes electric grid modernization through advanced conductors, requires transmission modernization studies, establishes NEPA categorical exclusions for certain projects, and adds high-performance transmission property to the clean electricity investment tax credit.
